name: qkd_d2d_cal_seq_pin_bc-bc2-COMMIT
purpose: KV link calendar sequencer with the boot cfg merged (KV-DCAL-BOOTCFG 10-19): boot target 11 loads the link-end tables + SEG2 bases through bcfg_*; the MU sequencer (ot_qwen_d2d_cal_seq_dies_mu.sv) keeps writing the runtime segment-1 bases (SEG1 after admission, SEG2 at each epoch) -- on the die today those writes were load-less, so every KV token run replayed the admission segment. One output register stage on every output (inner anchor EP_SKEW-2: epoch-anchored outputs on the pin-tile edges); sticky faults collision / boot-while-running / stale SEG2 / start-before-boot-base. Static, no credits.
